name: Kaiju Demolition Crew
source:
Have you ever wanted to date a kaiju AND have a minimum wage job? Well now you can have the best of both worlds in this short, text based game.

[From [url=https://charlock25.itch.io/kaiju-demolition-crew]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾想过，一边和怪兽约会，一边拿着最低工资打工？现在，这款短篇文字游戏就能让你两者兼得。

[摘自[url=https://charlock25.itch.io/kaiju-demolition-crew]itch.io[/url]]
